title: HGSS data layer — PKHeX registry tables bound under their own version provenance
source: PKHeX registry staged at hidden_files/data_registry/src/pkhex (Riley-approved data-only parsing, 2026-11-23); per-version separation kept — these are HeartGold/SoulSilver tables, never blended with the Crystal base layer (data/johto/) or any other version.
note: Binary registry resources in their native form (data only; PKHeX code is never built or run). personal_hgss = HGSS personal table; encounter_hg/encounter_ss = HGSS wild encounter tables kept as separate per-version files; encounter_walker4 = Pokewalker encounter data (exists only for HGSS; binds as data with no walker UI).
